thread:
deploy-bot: Canary alert: model-api us-west-2 showing error-rate 4.8% (threshold 3%). Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK to v3.5.0. rollout-id=5241. Reason: KV cache mismatch on /predict leading to 500s.

alex k: Is this global or isolated to a single pool?

deploy-bot: Region: us-west-2 only, affected pool: gpu-pool-7, traffic impacted ~12% of total. Canary slice = 10% traffic.

maria t: Heads-up — we have a customer demo in ~15m hitting us-west-2. Please DO NOT auto-rollback without manual ok.

samir r: Agreed with Maria. Propose manual hold of autopilot and targeted rollback for non-demo slices. We can pin demo route to current commit and shift other traffic back.

ops_jen: Can do targeted plan: 1) suppress auto-rollback, 2) create a 10% traffic-slice for demo pinned to v3.5.1, 3) roll the remaining 2% canary back to v3.5.0 to validate fix. Anyone object?

alex k: +1. How do we pin route? show command?

ops_jen: Use this quick command for pinning demo route:
```
releases pin --service model-api --version v3.5.1 --selector "route:demo" --reason "protect live demo"
```
And rollback command for canary slice:
```
deployctl rollback --release 5241 --to-version v3.5.0 --region us-west-2 --traffic-slice "non-demo"
```

liz p: I'll draft a 1-line customer note for the demo: "We're routing your session to a stable version of our inference service to ensure demo reliability; no action required on your side." Want to post to the customer slack channel?

maria t: Yes please post. Keep it simple, no internal jargon.

samir r: Ops — can you also create a short ticket and tag eng-runtime and eng-ml? We need a quick postmortem if the rollback doesn't resolve errors.

ops_jen: Ticket created: #INC-1423, assigned to eng-runtime. Suppressed auto-rollback until 1758888000 (deploy-bot flag). Rolling non-demo canary now. Monitoring p95/p50 and 5xx rate.

deploy-bot: Action log: autopilot suppressed by ops_jen. Rollback in progress for slice non-demo -> v3.5.0. Telemetry: collecting kvcache mismatch traces, sampling 10 requests per second.

alex k: Watching metrics. If errors stop after rollback, we release an updated build with KV cache fix and then roll forward after demo. If not, escalate to oncall.

liz p: Posted customer note to demo channel and DM'd the CSM. "Routing to stable version temporarily to avoid interruption." CSM confirmed.

maria t: Thanks all. :thumbsup: Keep the demo pinned until 18:30 PT or until we get a green on p95/errors.

samir r: Agreed. If we need to fully revert, we have runbook snippet ready: `runbook/revert-full.sh --release 5241`. Otherwise we do a controlled rollforward once fix validated.

ops_jen: Update: non-demo canary rollback completed, 5xx dropped to 0.9% in us-west-2. Keeping demo pinned. Closing this thread after 30m if stable; will open follow-up for root-cause.

deploy-bot: NOTE: auto-rollback remained suppressed; will notify if any new triggers occur.

alex k: Thanks. Postmortem assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml, brief notes due by EOD.

liz p: I'll add a short blurb to the release notes: "Hot rollback executed for a subset of canary traffic in us-west-2 due to KV cache errors; demo sessions pinned to stable. Monitoring and follow-up underway."

ops_jen: Closing ops actions here. If anyone needs to reopen, reply in thread.
